title: Book Three · Chapter 2: One Lap
story:
By lunch, Ronan knows the girl's name.

Anna.

She writes it at the top of her exercise book. Ronan looks once, then opens his own lunch.

“Ronan,” she says. “Did I say it right?”

“Yes.”

“Good. I heard three names at once this morning.”

He points toward the next desk. “I know his face. Not his name yet.”

Anna looks over. The boy is talking with his mouth full.

“We can wait,” she says.

Ronan laughs and takes a bite of rice.

Anna eats quickly, but she leaves her lunch box open. She has one piece of egg left.

“Do you want the window open?” Ronan asks.

“A little.”

He pushes it out. Air moves across the desk. Anna puts her hand on her loose paper.

“Thank you. I want to go outside after lunch.”

“To the yard?”

“To the running track. I saw it from upstairs.”

Ronan follows her finger. Beyond the small yard, white lines curve around a wide field.

“Do you run?” she asks.

“Usually for the bell.”

“Then you already practise.”

He smiles. Anna finishes her egg and closes the box.

“I want to try the track.”

“Do you know the way?”

“Not yet. I came to find it.”

They leave their books on the desk and go downstairs. At the far end of the yard, a path leads to the field.

Anna stops beside the white lines. She looks around the long curve.

“One lap?” she asks.

Ronan looks at the far end.

“All the way round?”

“Yes. Back to here.”

He puts his water bottle on a bench. Anna puts hers beside it.

“Not a race,” she says.

“Good.”

They start slowly. Anna's shoes make a light sound beside his. After the first turn, she moves ahead.

Ronan tries to stay close. Soon he is breathing harder.

Halfway round, he slows down.

Anna looks back. She is breathing hard too.

“Still coming?”

“Yes. Slower.”

She nods and keeps going. She does not call again.

Ronan looks toward the next turn. He can reach that. He runs to it, then takes the last part more slowly.

Anna is at the bench when he comes back. She holds both bottles out.

“Yours has the blue top?”

“Yes.”

He takes it and sits down. His breath is loud in his own ears.

“You said it was not a race.”

“It wasn't.”

“You reached the end first.”

“Someone has to.”

He laughs, then takes another drink.

Anna sits at the other end of the bench. For a moment, neither speaks.

Ronan looks across the field. He wants to tell Leo about the long curve. Then he remembers the address inside his birthday book.

The bell rings from the building.

Anna stands. “More practice?”

Ronan shakes his head.

“We can walk.”

They go back together. At the stairs, Anna waits while he ties a loose lace.

Inside the classroom, his notebook is still on his half of the desk. He sits down beside her and opens it to a clean page.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

track＝跑道；lap＝绕跑道一圈；curve＝弯曲处；breathing hard＝喘着气。

## 理解问题

1. Anna想在午间做什么？她对新学校是否已经很熟悉？
2. Ronan跑到一半后怎样完成这一圈？

## 读句子

**Anna waits while he ties a loose lace.**

拆开看：Anna / waits / while he ties a loose lace.

Anna／等着／在他系好松开的鞋带时。
